recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-28544 follow-up is needed in core; future ownership/authorship model changes should proceed through new Patient Care decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-28544 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested renaming CarePlan.author to CarePlan.custodian, defining custodian as the responsible party to whom the care plan is attributed, noting the custodian may or may not be a contributor, updating contributor to include individuals, organizations, or devices that provided the contents, and adding a custodian search parameter.
initial_application: Commit decdf89f815a9a83ec5a2669d36eff07496fa083 explicitly applied FHIR-28544 by changing source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml from CarePlan.author to CarePlan.custodian, updating the custodian comment and contributor definition, and adding source/careplan/bundle-CarePlan-search-params.xml entry CarePlan-custodian. Later fhir.ini history added the expected R4-to-R5 map CarePlan.author=@CarePlan.custodian.
additional_context: The Jira-linked Zulip thread and Patient Care meeting evidence support the selected rename rather than a separate extension. Later FHIR-33954 reaffirmed that authorship/development belongs under contributor rather than redefining custodian, and FHIR-48444 refined only FiveWs mappings while preserving the custodian/contributor semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current source edit is needed. CarePlan.custodian and CarePlan.contributor have the approved definitions in the active CarePlan StructureDefinition source, and CarePlan-custodian exists in the active CarePlan search parameter bundle.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change decision states CarePlan.author had already been renamed to custodian by FHIR-28544 and that proposed authorship wording belongs under contributor.
Applied later decision removed the FiveWs.author mapping from CarePlan.custodian and mapped CarePlan.contributor to FiveWs.source without changing the FHIR-28544 rename or definitions.
